data.gender_notes: Ayusha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ayusha is derived from the Arabic word 'ayuš', which means 'life' or 'existence'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the continuous cycle of life and the importance of cherishing every moment. The name Ayusha carries the meaning “Life, Existence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayusha usually hope their child will grow to embody life, existence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
